title: Intrinsic Attention as Navigator: A Non-Generative Retrieval Method for Multi-Hop Queries
abstract: arXiv:2611.18617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For multi-hop queries in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), it is crucial to accurately obtain evidence pieces. In this study, we propose a training-free method for multi-hop query retrieval, named Intrinsic Navigating-based Non-Generative Retrieval (IN-Retriever). Instead of generating intermediate reasoning text, the method extracts the bridging clue from the internal attention of the embedding model based on the current context and retrieved candidate documents. During iterative clue extraction and document retrieval, IN-Retriever strips away revealed clues from the embedded query vector and then reranks candidate documents in a targeted manner, thereby steering retrieval toward hidden next-hop evidence. In the experiments, we confirm the feasibility and effectiveness of using intrinsic attention signals to guide external multi-hop retrieval. translated_title: 内在注意力作为导航器：一种面向多跳查询的非生成式检索方法
translated_abstract: 在检索增强生成（RAG）的多跳查询中，准确获取证据片段至关重要。在本研究中，我们提出了一种无需训练的多跳查询检索方法，命名为基于内在导航的非生成式检索。该方法不生成中间推理文本，而是基于当前上下文和已检索的候选文档，从嵌入模型的内部注意力中提取桥接线索。在迭代进行线索提取和文档检索的过程中，IN-Retriever 从嵌入的查询向量中剥离已揭示的线索，然后有针对性地对候选文档进行重排序，从而将检索导向隐藏的下一跳证据。在实验中，我们证实了利用内在注意力信号引导外部多跳检索的可行性和有效性。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够精确地收集足够的文档来支持……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的非生成式检索方法IN-Retriever，通过利用嵌入模型的内在注意力迭代提取桥接线索、剥离已发现线索并重排序候选文档，无需生成中间推理文本即可将检索精确导向多跳查询的下一跳证据。
en_tdlr: IN-Retriever is a training-free, non-generative retrieval method that leverages the embedding model's intrinsic attention to iteratively extract bridging clues and rerank candidates, steering retrieval toward hidden next-hop evidence for multi-hop queries without generating intermediate reasoning text.
